facts.business: Bluspring Enterprises Limited is India's only nationally scaled, people-powered, compliance-first, technology-enabled integrated infrastructure services enterprise delivering six service lines — facility management, food and hospitality, security, engineering, telecom network services, and talent platform — through a unified operating model.
key_risks: Workforce formalisation and compliance with new Labour Codes
Dependence on outsourcing intensity across sectors
Technology enablement and digital transformation execution
Sustainability and ESG compliance requirements from clients
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited, FFHL Group Ltd., Fairfax (Barbados) International Corp., Isaac Enterprises LLP, HWIC Asia Fund Class A Shares, and various subsidiaries including Vedang Cellular Services Private Limited, Monster.com (India) Private Limited, Terrier Security Services (India) Private Limited, and others. Entities controlled by promoters include Fairbridge Capital Private Limited, Thomas Cook (India) Limited, and others.
